name: harness-lab
description: Local-first project planning workspace with Kanban and desktop apps

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check board.js && node --check project.js && node --check planner.js && node --check i18n.js && node --check sw.js && node --check server.js && node --check codex-bridge.js && node --check scripts/test.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/create-icons.mjs && node --check electron/main.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test scripts/codex-bridge.test.cjs scripts/model-settings.test.cjs && node scripts/test.mjs && node scripts/runtime-test.mjs && node scripts/controls-test.mjs && node scripts/audit-test.mjs
scripts.package:desktop:win: npm run prepare:icons && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:linux: npm run prepare:icons && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:mac: npm run prepare:icons && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
